clauses.reason: This clause (the operative lead, the amending command restating section 301(a) of Part III of EO 10973) continued, amended, as part of EO 10973 until that parent order was revoked. EO 12163 of September 29, 1979, Sec. 1-903(a)(1) revokes Executive Order No. 10973 of November 3,1961, as amended (44 FR 56673-56680), and Sec. 1-905 makes the order effective as of October 1, 1979, so the first end is October 1, 1979 (the signing date September 29, 1979 is not the effective date). EO 11959 of January 18, 1977, Sec. 6 amended section 301 to read as follows and is recorded as a later amendment event with a note for the human reviewer that the substance of section 301 changed; it did not end the Treasury delegation.

This clause (the restated text (a) of section 301(a) naming the delegated Foreign Assistance Act functions) continued, amended, as part of EO 10973 until that parent order was revoked. EO 12163 of September 29, 1979, Sec. 1-903(a)(1) revokes Executive Order No. 10973 of November 3,1961, as amended (44 FR 56673-56680), and Sec. 1-905 makes the order effective as of October 1, 1979, so the first end is October 1, 1979 (the signing date September 29, 1979 is not the effective date). EO 11959 of January 18, 1977, Sec. 6 amended section 301 to read as follows and is recorded as a later amendment event with a note for the human reviewer that the substance of section 301 changed; it did not end the Treasury delegation.

research_rationale:
EO 11816 (October 23, 1974) restated section 301(a) of Part III of EO 10973, as amended, delegating certain Foreign Assistance Act reporting functions (section 514(a)(2) and (b), the second sentence of section 612(a), and section 634(f) and (g)) to the Secretary of the Treasury. Under the strike-and-insert ruling an amendment continues, amended, until the parent order ends. EO 12163 of September 29, 1979, Sec. 1-903(a)(1), revoked Executive Order No. 10973 of November 3, 1961, as amended, and its Sec. 1-905 makes the order effective as of October 1, 1979. The status is NO: the parent order was revoked effective October 1, 1979.

savings.reason: EO 12163 Sec. 1-904 (Saving Provisions) preserves delegations and actions made with respect to any function affected by it, not revoked or made inapplicable before its date, except to the extent inconsistent with it, until amended, modified or terminated by appropriate authority; EO 12163 also re-allocates foreign assistance functions in its own text. The EO 11816 delegation therefore passed into the new allocation rather than continuing independently under EO 11816.
